blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Palace on Sunday said dropping the bribery charge in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial could deprive Filipinos of the chance to know the “whole truth.” “If they withdraw the bribery allegation against the vice president, wouldn’t that shortchange or disadvantage Filipinos who want to know the whole truth about this?” Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said in a message to reporters. While Castro respects the prosecution panel’s decision, she questioned what prompted it to give up the charge.
